source.dramatic_purpose: Reveal Haeun's own name on the empty bottle and turn curiosity into personal fear.

camera.position: just behind Haeun's left shoulder at bottle-shelf height
camera.focus: the empty bottle and its worn name tag, with Haeun's shocked eye still readable

subjects.pose: left shoulder and partial profile leaning toward the shelf
subjects.expression: eye widened in sudden recognition and fear
subjects.gaze: fixed on the empty bottle in frame center-right
subjects.action: raises her left hand but stops before touching the bottle
identity_invariants: navy cord on raised left wrist

background.description: close section of the fixed east-wall wooden bottle shelves, rain tracking down the wall behind them
background.perspective: shelf lines recede gently toward frame right without warping the bottle
depth_layers: rows of softly blurred filled bottles and wet wall
background.lighting: cool diffuse rain light with a small amber reflection inside the empty glass

art_direction.line: controlled clean webtoon linework with sharper detail on the eye, hand, glass rim, and tag
art_direction.color: cool restrained palette, amber tag and reflection as the only warm accent
art_direction.rendering: polished 2D cel shading, realistic glass edges, shallow depth of field
art_direction.composition: empty bottle dominates the center-right; Haeun's partial face and hovering hand form a visual triangle

state_out: Haeun has recognized her name tag
her left hand hovers without touching
